ambient: 病房尽头的监护仪轻轻响了两声，又恢复了平稳。
值班室的电话响了一声就断了，大概是打错了。
后院的窗棂被风吹得咯咯作响。
远处传来推车轮子碾过地砖的声音，渐渐远了。
comment: Scenario C (V0.2-B B4 generalization test, written by a non-implementer from the data contract only): a clinic night shift. The night nurse privately knows the fever medicine is nearly out; the on-call doctor privately knows a fever patient will be admitted tonight. The nurse's restock goal only activates once she learns of the admission (from the doctor, or from the admission form in his office); the doctor's readiness goal only completes once he learns the restock happened. Location graph is a 4-cycle plus one leaf (triage-ward-yard-pharmacy-triage, oncall leaf) — not isomorphic to the tavern/warehouse tree.

med_low_report: {name}：不瞒你说，病房柜子里的退烧药已经见底了。
{name}：退烧药就剩个底儿，真来病人怕是不够。
speech_lines.patient_inquire: {name}：听说今晚要来个高烧的病人？消息准吗？
patient_notice: {name}：刚接的电话——今晚要收一个高烧病人，提前准备一下。
{name}：跟你说一声，后半夜有个发高烧的要送来。
speech_lines.restock_inquire: {name}：退烧药补上了没有？我这边等着确认。
restock_report: {name}：退烧药已经补上了，放在我手边，随时能用。
smalltalk: {name}：今晚夜班，但愿后半夜能太平些。
{name}：走廊的灯又闪了，明天得让电工看看。
speech_lines.stock_inquire: {name}：病房那边的退烧药，还够用吗？
